defect: FALSE AS FROZEN — finite-window hypotheses vs infinite-tail conclusion. The hypotheses rank(hankel g (r+1)) = rank(hankel g (r+2)) = r constrain only g(0..2r+2); the conclusion constrains rank(hankel g n) for ALL n ≥ r and mcMillan g, which depend on the unconstrained tail. Counterexample (r = 0, p = m = 1, 𝕜 = ℚ): g k = 0 for k ≤ 2, g 3 = 1; hypotheses hold (both Hankels zero), conclusion fails at n = 3 (nonzero entry ⇒ rank ≥ 1) and mcMillan g = 4 ≠ 0.
